# OSK Tailor

> Kurs prawa jazdy kat. B w Gdańsku: biuro 5 min od Dworca Głównego, auta jak w PORD, teoria online 24/7. TOP 10 zdawalności w PORD Gdańsk w II półroczu 2025.

OSK Tailor is a family-run driving school in Gdańsk, Poland, teaching category B (car) courses on manual (Kia Rio 4) and automatic (Skoda Kamiq) cars. Its office is in the Zieleniak building (ul. Wały Piastowskie 1, lok. 508D, 80-855 Gdańsk), 5 minutes from Gdańsk Główny station. Theory is taught online with 24/7 access for 120 days; the standard course costs 4200 PLN and can be paid in two 0% instalments.

## Key facts

- Practical exam pass rate (cat. B, PORD Gdańsk, 01.07.2025–30.06.2026): OSK Tailor 43.6% (140 exams) vs 44.0% average of Gdańsk schools and 32.35% for all candidates. Registered in PORD reports as MK Drift Michał Krawiec (no. 02002261).
- Course includes: online theory 24/7 for 120 days, first-aid training with a paramedic, 30 h of driving, internal practical exam, flexible scheduling, option to change instructor.
- Extra costs outside the school: medical exam ~200 PLN, photo ~50 PLN, PORD theory exam 59 PLN, PORD practical exam 239 PLN, licence issue 100 PLN.
- Google rating 4.9 (143 reviews, November 2026). Award: Złota Firma.
- Contact: +48 725 563 155 (phone, WhatsApp), biuro@osktailor.pl. Office hours Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00.
- Legal entity: MK Drift Michał Krawiec, NIP 5783086901.
